q2_gaps: bare locative direct object of a motion verb ('leaves the gate') — spatial roles (Source/Goal) are licensed only for prepositional phrases, so the source-of-departure sense has no encoding and the object falls through to the default Theme
notes: Judged against the instruction set as written the parse is correct: a transitive inanimate subject stays Agent, an unchanged object defaults to Theme, and the bare simple present takes no status atom.
